scripts_runtime_note: task_v07/ and configs/ entries must match across attempts and are enforced; scripts/ entries may differ because the resume entry point is newer code, so they are listed here

unfinished.note: unfinished skeletons stay in every skeleton-level denominator and are listed in the 未完成 column; they contribute no group proposals

scope.note: tables cover the union of the attempts' declared skeleton_id sets; the final batch declares all registered skeletons, so this list is then empty

proposal_field_note: one proposals.jsonl line is one group proposal; accepted means record['reason'] is None

draw_appendix.note: one row per common draw (family x slot); the five intents of a draw share one common_draw, so a draw is the independent unit. Appendix only: T1-T6 are unchanged. 未完成 is a fourth class for draws whose five intents are not all measured; such draws stay in every denominator.

T6_population: T6 distribution covers skeletons that have a planning_result.json; t6_all_registered additionally covers unfinished skeletons' recorded wall clock
